p11/esc1098:0.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:0.text: hi! Hope you are doing well today

p11/esc1098:10.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:10.text: I love that idea! I think I’ll feel much better if I take that time to just relax before I really start working.

p11/esc1098:11.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:11.text: There is a famous quote " Worry is a total waste of time. It doesn't change anything. All it does is steal your joy and keep you busy doing nothing."

p11/esc1098:12.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:12.text: Whoever said that sure knew what they were talking about. It’s so true!

p11/esc1098:13.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:13.text: Any snack recommendations? I’ve got some fruit on hand, but it’s a little boring by itself lol

p11/esc1098:14.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:14.text: I definitely recommend trail mix or chex mix and one of my favorites is banana chips!

p11/esc1098:15.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:15.text: I don’t think I’ve ever tried banana chips! I’ll have to see if my grocery store has got them. Maybe I can get some delivered by the time I’m ready to study

p11/esc1098:16.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:16.text: you can find it in any grocery store easily known as  Plantain chips

p11/esc1098:17.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:17.text: hope you are feeling much better now

p11/esc1098:18.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:18.text: Thanks so much! I’ve added them and some of my favorite trail mix to my cart. Should be delivered in 1 hour!

p11/esc1098:19.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:19.text: I am feeling better. Thanks so much for the advice :)

p11/esc1098:2.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:2.text: Hey! I’ve been better. Just so stressed out! I don’t handle pressure well.

p11/esc1098:20.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:20.text: That's great to know and best wishes for your exams.

p11/esc1098:21.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:21.text: Thank you. Enjoy the rest of your day!

p11/esc1098:3.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:3.text: Something is pressuring you and you are stressed due to that. Correct me if I am wrong

p11/esc1098:4.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:4.text: That’s right. I have three final exams next week and I’ve had the flu so I haven’t been able to study at all.

p11/esc1098:5.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:5.text: It must be hard for you to prepare for it. I can understand. But there must be a way

p11/esc1098:6.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:6.text: I’m sure I can figure something out. I’ll definitely have to study all weekend. I just really need to pass. Do you know any good tricks to help study?

p11/esc1098:7.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:7.text: I can easily see your seriousness and dedication for  your studies. That is awesome thing

p11/esc1098:8.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1098:8.text: Thanks! Education is very important in my family. My dad was a teacher so I’ve always had to live up to high expectations.

p11/esc1098:9.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1098:9.text: you should take a complete rest for 2-3 hours without worrying and then get up and eat something tasty and healthy. Afterwards sit for preparing for your exam. That's what I do and it helps me a lot.

p11/esc1216:0.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:0.text: I feel heavy pressures from my parents, they also want me to be the top of the class but I find it tough because they are other top students

p11/esc1216:10.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:10.text: Most of the parents behave like this when it is regarding their kids future. When I was in school same thing happened with mw. They know us very well I realized now.  Try to talk to them everyday for a while. It might work.

p11/esc1216:11.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:11.text: Maybe you're right! Although, my parents have a very busy schedule but fingers crossed when I do find time to talk to them they will understand me.

p11/esc1216:12.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:12.text: I sometimes feel like someone older needs to talk to them, maybe then my parents may take it more seriously

p11/esc1216:13.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:13.text: Well! Thanks I give what you said a go

p11/esc1216:14.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:14.text: Hope you are feeling bit relaxed now.

p11/esc1216:15.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:15.text: Yes! I feel a lot better now that I know someone understands how I feel

p11/esc1216:16.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:16.text: I am glad that I am able to make you happy.

p11/esc1216:18.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:18.text: How should I respond to the friends that are ganging up on me?

p11/esc1216:19.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:19.text: sure! You don't have to worry about that. that should be their problem. just ignore them or don't give attention. They will stop doing it for sure.

p11/esc1216:2.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:2.text: Hi! how are you doing today?

p11/esc1216:20.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:20.text: Hmm..interesting because now that I think about it, I believe this could have contributed to the stress and anxieties that I have been experiencing. When I don't get support from anyone I feel so alone, timid and down

p11/esc1216:21.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:21.text: Try to take small break while studying and try to relax

p11/esc1216:22.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:22.text: Yes, I find that has helped me a bit also because I have quite a short attention span . Also, I am currently on the path of trying to find more unique techniques to help revision more fun and exciting for me

p11/esc1216:23.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:23.text: That's great! you will do awesome.

p11/esc1216:24.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:24.text: Thank you very much! I feel much better now and I've taken on board what you said, hopefully there will be a positive change in my parents character. :)

p11/esc1216:26.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:26.text: Alright! Well I'll talk to you some other time to give an update

p11/esc1216:3.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:3.text: Not so good, I'm feeling down

p11/esc1216:4.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:4.text: It sounds like you have low energy. What makes you feel down?

p11/esc1216:5.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:5.text: My parents keep putting pressures on me to be the best in the class and with my learning difficulties I am finding it had to cope

p11/esc1216:6.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:6.text: I can understand parental pressure. They want to see you to be a successful person. Sometime it is overwhelming. you should talk to them that you are doing your best.

p11/esc1216:7.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:7.text: I have tried, I am even doing extra classes but they still keep on putting pressure on me. On top of that all my friends have distant from me for no reason and they ganged up on me to bully me

p11/esc1216:8.speaker: supporter
p11/esc1216:8.text: It must be tough time for you. show your work report to your parents and try to tell them all the people are born with different potential.

p11/esc1216:9.speaker: seeker
p11/esc1216:9.text: Hmm...That doesn't seem like a bad idea. I am just worry that my parents will not be very understanding. My parents are too strict and they don't like to hear any complaints or excuses.

p11/esc427:10.speaker: seeker
p11/esc427:10.text: I think it might be the fear of failure that triggered it

p11/esc427:11.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:11.text: Research has shown that fear of failure does stem from feelings of anxiety, but is it possible to look at fear of failure from a different perspective?

p11/esc427:12.speaker: seeker
p11/esc427:12.text: I think it might be possible to look at it from a different perspective

p11/esc427:13.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:13.text: Do you think you can channel your fear of failure into positive energy?

p11/esc427:15.speaker: seeker
p11/esc427:15.text: How do you think I could do that?

p11/esc427:16.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:16.text: You can turn your anxiety into extra energy to plan and prepare.

p11/esc427:17.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:17.text: Having anxiety can give you a boost of energy, which gives you an advantage to achieve your goal.

p11/esc427:18.speaker: seeker
p11/esc427:18.text: I can probably do that, the anxiety can motivate me to create a studying plan

p11/esc427:19.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:19.text: Yes, indeed. Having anxiety will keep you anchored to your study plan which would increase your ability to perform well for the exam.

p11/esc427:21.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:21.text: Awesome! In addition, as you follow your study plan, remember to pace yourself.

p11/esc427:22.speaker: seeker
p11/esc427:22.text: I will do that, thank you for your help

p11/esc427:23.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:23.text: You are welcome, I hope this session was helpful.

p11/esc427:3.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:3.text: I am doing well and how are you feeling today?

p11/esc427:4.speaker: seeker
p11/esc427:4.text: I'm feeling okay today, a bit anxious for my finals this week

p11/esc427:5.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:5.text: Thank you for sharing, feeling anxious days before an exam is a normal.

p11/esc427:6.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:6.text: I am also anxious about my upcoming exam this week.

p11/esc427:8.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:8.text: I am preparing to sit to become a clinical counselor. I can relate to feeling anxious. You are not alone.

p11/esc427:9.speaker: supporter
p11/esc427:9.text: What do you think is triggering your anxiety?

p11/esc768:10.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:10.text: it seems to me that you feel you can not trust a friend, correct me if im wrong?

p11/esc768:11.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:11.text: I trust my friends very much. They won't show the same trustfulness on me.

p11/esc768:12.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:12.text: Oh ok, have you asked them why they feel they can not trust you?

p11/esc768:13.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:13.text: Maybe you could have a conversation about it and see what you could do to gain their trust.

p11/esc768:14.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:14.text: I have had a friend not to trust me and i know how hurtful that can feel, maybe there has just been some sort of misunderstanding.

p11/esc768:15.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:15.text: They think I am not suitable for some places. They want to go that places without my knowledge is not a problem. But they hide the total matter

p11/esc768:16.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:16.text: It may be misunderstanding. I tried to talk with them.

p11/esc768:18.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:18.text: Could it be that it is not that they do not trust you but they feel you would not feel comfortable going to such places?

p11/esc768:19.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:19.text: If they feel uncomfortable , they could speak directly but they won't did that also

p11/esc768:20.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:20.text: I am sorry you feel ignored sometimes people choose to ignore issues rather than confront them and try to come to some sort of solution, i would try not to take it to personnel as you seem like a very friendly person.

p11/esc768:21.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:21.text: You could try to send a message just stating that your feelings are hurt and it would be nice if they would at least reply back with a explanation on why they have made you feel this way.

p11/esc768:22.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:22.text: Can you any idea to get out from this?

p11/esc768:23.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:23.text: Are you asking how to end the chat?

p11/esc768:25.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:25.text: how to get out from my depression?

p11/esc768:26.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:26.text: I think you need to spend some time doing something you enjoy to try to take your mind off of it, maybe go to a movie or for a nice walk.

p11/esc768:27.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:27.text: Or if you have a family member you are close to you could speak to them about it and see what the perspective of the situation is.

p11/esc768:29.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:29.text: I got a little bit idea

p11/esc768:30.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:30.text: I will try to explore it

p11/esc768:31.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:31.text: is there any general way to get out from stress?

p11/esc768:32.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:32.text: No problem you really seem like a nice person so i think the problem more so is with them and not you so try not to let it ruin your holiday season!

p11/esc768:33.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:33.text: When i am stressed or depressed I like to workout and listen to music.

p11/esc768:34.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:34.text: I like to read book. Shall I try this?

p11/esc768:35.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:35.text: Yes getting lost in a good book is a great way to get your mind off of it!

p11/esc768:36.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:36.text: Thank you friend. Shall we end the chat?

p11/esc768:37.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:37.text: If you feel i have helped you we can, if not i am glad to stay and continue trying to help.

p11/esc768:38.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:38.text: I feel very happy about your help

p11/esc768:39.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:39.text: i am glad i could be of some help i hope you feel better soon!

p11/esc768:40.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:40.text: Ok buddy. Thank you and bye.

p11/esc768:5.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:5.text: i am so sorry to hear that. what seems to be worrying you today?

p11/esc768:6.speaker: supporter
p11/esc768:6.text: i am doing ok thanks for asking

p11/esc768:7.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:7.text: I trust my friends blindly. But they not.

p11/esc768:8.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:8.text: It creates depression on my mind

p11/esc768:9.speaker: seeker
p11/esc768:9.text: I cannot concentrate on any other works

p11/esc860:10.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:10.text: I am having a really hard day today

p11/esc860:12.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:12.text: this is a safe place with no judgement express yourself in what way you would like

p11/esc860:13.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:13.text: I got grounded becuase my parents found out that I recently started dating before age 18. I am 17 and feel like I should be able to have a boyfriend now

p11/esc860:14.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:14.text: Ah i understand. I am sorry about that.

p11/esc860:15.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:15.text: Why do you think you should have a boydriend now?

p11/esc860:16.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:16.text: Also i can relate to what you have been to I was once a 17 year old whos parents did not want her to have a boyfriend as well.

p11/esc860:17.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:17.text: I have waited till age 17 as I knew this was best for me. The boy is my childhood best friend and has waited for years just to be with me and only me

p11/esc860:18.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:18.text: Ok wow that is a very good position to be in. Now I want you to consider your parents perception why would you think that your parents might not want you to have a boyfriend?

p11/esc860:19.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:19.text: Becuase they are trying to control me and dont want me to be happy and to be alone forever

p11/esc860:20.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:20.text: I understand, Parents are complicated creatures. As an adult maybr your parents are worried about your saftey?

p11/esc860:21.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:21.text: Or maybe they dont want to see thire kid grow up that fast your are almost 18!

p11/esc860:22.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:22.text: Why would they worry about my safety? They have raised me to make decisions and I fel like I have made a good one waiting this long and in my own choice of the guy I chose to start a relationship with

p11/esc860:23.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:23.text: Parents worry about thire kids all the time. you know pedophiles, kidnappers and a a lot of other dangerous people out there. it is only natural for parents to worry

p11/esc860:24.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:24.text: Well, I guess I understand a bit more put like that.

p11/esc860:25.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:25.text: Since we might run out of time soon can I give you my advice to you as well?

p11/esc860:27.speaker: supporter
p11/esc860:27.text: my advice is too fold 1) demonstrate how mature you are to your parents think of it like a job interview. when you bring this issue up speak in a nonconfirmational tone. 3. patience. it takes time to change minds.

p11/esc860:5.speaker: seeker
p11/esc860:5.text: Please talk to me I need help!

p11/p11_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:0.text: Hi Anna, how have things been going for you lately?

p11/p11_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:1.text: Hey, it's been a bit tough to be honest.

p11/p11_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:10.text: It's important to stay true to yourself while also considering the relationship. Have you talked to him about how you're feeling?

p11/p11_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:11.text: We did talk, but it didn't go well. We both ended up just getting more upset.

p11/p11_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:12.text: I'm sorry to hear that it escalated. Sometimes it can be helpful to take a break and approach the conversation with a fresh perspective.

p11/p11_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:13.text: Yeah, we haven't spoken much since the fight. I'm hoping we can find a way to discuss things more calmly.

p11/p11_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:14.text: That's a good goal. It might also help to think about what aspects of your goals are most important to you, and where you might have some flexibility.

p11/p11_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:15.text: That's true. I know I'll probably have to make some compromises, I just need to figure out which ones I'm okay with.

p11/p11_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:16.text: It sounds like you're being very thoughtful about the situation. It's okay to take your time to figure these things out.

p11/p11_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:17.text: Thanks. I just want to find a way to make things work between us without giving up too much of myself.

p11/p11_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:18.text: Having that intention is important. You deserve to have a relationship where you feel respected and supported in pursuing your own dreams too.

p11/p11_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:19.text: I hope so. It's just hard when someone you care about seems to be on a different path.

p11/p11_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about what's been happening?

p11/p11_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:20.text: It's completely understandable. Relationships often require understanding and patience from both sides.

p11/p11_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:21.text: I'll try to keep that in mind. Thanks for listening, it helps a lot to talk things through.

p11/p11_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:22.text: Anytime, Anna. I'm here for you whenever you need to talk. You're not alone in this.

p11/p11_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:3.text: Yeah, I had a fight with my boyfriend recently, and it's been weighing on me a lot.

p11/p11_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:4.text: That sounds really challenging. What was the fight about, if you don't mind sharing?

p11/p11_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:5.text: It was about our priorities and goals for the future. We seem to be on different pages, and I'm not sure how to handle it.

p11/p11_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:6.text: That can definitely be a hard topic to navigate. How are you feeling about the differences in your priorities?

p11/p11_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:7.text: I feel torn because I really care about him, but our visions for the future just aren't aligning right now.

p11/p11_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_1:8.text: It sounds like you're in a tough spot, wanting to find a balance between your feelings for him and your own future plans.

p11/p11_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_1:9.text: Exactly. I just don't want to lose him over this, but I also don't want to compromise too much on what I want for my future.

p11/p11_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:0.text: Hey Anna, it's good to see you online. How are you doing today?

p11/p11_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:1.text: Hi... honestly, not so great. It's been a rough week.

p11/p11_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:10.text: That sounds like so much to carry all at once, Anna. It’s understandable to feel overwhelmed. What do you feel you need right now?

p11/p11_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:11.text: I think I need to figure out what I actually want for my future without feeling like I'm letting everyone down.

p11/p11_conv_2:12.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:12.text: That's a really important realization. It's your future, after all. Have you had any thoughts about what interests or excites you?

p11/p11_conv_2:13.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:13.text: I love art and writing, but I'm not sure if that's practical. It feels risky compared to more traditional paths.

p11/p11_conv_2:14.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:14.text: Pursuing your passions is important, and finding a balance is possible. Perhaps exploring these interests, even as a hobby, could help you feel more connected to what you love?

p11/p11_conv_2:15.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:15.text: That might actually be a good idea. Maybe starting with small steps could clarify things without committing everything right now.

p11/p11_conv_2:16.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:16.text: Starting small sounds like a great plan. You don't have to have everything figured out at once. It's okay to take your time.

p11/p11_conv_2:17.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:17.text: Thanks for saying that. I think I’ll try talking to my parents again once I've thought more about what I want.

p11/p11_conv_2:18.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:18.text: That sounds like a positive step forward. I'm here for you, and remember, it's okay to ask for this space to explore your interests.

p11/p11_conv_2:19.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:19.text: Thanks for listening. It really helps to talk about it.

p11/p11_conv_2:2.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?

p11/p11_conv_2:20.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:20.text: Anytime, Anna. You're doing your best, and that's all anyone can ask for. Let me know how things go, okay?

p11/p11_conv_2:3.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:3.text: Yeah, I had an argument with my parents about my future plans, and it got really intense.

p11/p11_conv_2:4.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:4.text: That sounds tough. What was the argument about, if you're comfortable sharing?

p11/p11_conv_2:5.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:5.text: They want me to focus on getting into a good university, but I'm not even sure what I want to study yet.

p11/p11_conv_2:6.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:6.text: It can be really overwhelming when you're not sure about your path, and there's pressure from others. How did that make you feel?

p11/p11_conv_2:7.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:7.text: I just felt trapped and like I was disappointing them. It reminded me of the fight I had with my boyfriend about future plans too.

p11/p11_conv_2:8.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_2:8.text: It's natural to feel that way when expectations feel piled up. How's everything with your boyfriend now?

p11/p11_conv_2:9.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_2:9.text: We haven't really resolved things. It's this limbo where everything feels uncertain, and now my parents add to that stress.

p11/p11_conv_3:0.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:0.text: Hey, are you there? I could really use someone to talk to.

p11/p11_conv_3:1.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:1.text: Hi Anna, I'm here for you. What's going on?

p11/p11_conv_3:10.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:10.text: Yeah, I've been trying to balance everything, like pleasing my parents and figuring out my future. It's just a lot.

p11/p11_conv_3:11.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:11.text: It sounds like you're dealing with so much at once, and that's truly challenging. Have you been able to talk to your parents after the argument?

p11/p11_conv_3:12.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:12.text: Not really. We've been kind of avoiding the topic, and it's been tense at home.

p11/p11_conv_3:13.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:13.text: That sounds tough. Maybe finding a way to express how you're feeling to them could help lighten the load on you.

p11/p11_conv_3:14.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:14.text: Yeah, but I'm not sure how to do that without it turning into another fight.

p11/p11_conv_3:15.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:15.text: I understand. Maybe writing down your thoughts first could help organize what you want to say.

p11/p11_conv_3:16.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:16.text: That's a good idea. I could try writing a letter or something.

p11/p11_conv_3:17.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:17.text: That sounds like a constructive way to communicate. Plus, it gives them time to understand your perspective.

p11/p11_conv_3:18.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:18.text: I hope so. I just want some peace and to focus on my studies.

p11/p11_conv_3:19.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:19.text: And you deserve that peace. You're doing your best, and that's what counts.

p11/p11_conv_3:2.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:2.text: I just got my midterm results and they weren't good at all.

p11/p11_conv_3:20.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:20.text: Thanks. It helps to know I'm not alone in this.

p11/p11_conv_3:21.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:21.text: You're definitely not alone. I'm here anytime you need to talk.

p11/p11_conv_3:22.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:22.text: I appreciate it a lot. I'll start working on that letter and try to focus on my upcoming finals.

p11/p11_conv_3:23.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:23.text: That sounds like a solid plan. Remember to take breaks and take care of yourself too.

p11/p11_conv_3:24.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:24.text: I will, and I'll check in with you if I need more support.

p11/p11_conv_3:25.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:25.text: I look forward to it. You've got this, Anna.

p11/p11_conv_3:3.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:3.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. It sounds really disappointing. Do you want to talk about it?

p11/p11_conv_3:4.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:4.text: Yeah, I just feel like I'm under a lot of pressure right now. Everything seems to be piling up.

p11/p11_conv_3:5.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:5.text: That's totally understandable, especially with finals coming up too. It can feel overwhelming.

p11/p11_conv_3:6.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:6.text: Exactly, and I'm scared I won't be able to do better next time.

p11/p11_conv_3:7.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:7.text: It's natural to feel scared, but remember you have the strength to improve. Do you have any thoughts about why it didn't go well?

p11/p11_conv_3:8.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_3:8.text: I think part of it is because I haven't been managing my time well. And I've been so distracted since the argument with my parents.

p11/p11_conv_3:9.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_3:9.text: That makes sense. It must be hard to focus with so many things on your mind.

p11/p11_conv_4:0.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:0.text: Hey Anna, I remember you mentioning how much Lily means to you. How are you holding up with everything that's been going on?

p11/p11_conv_4:1.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:1.text: Hey. Honestly, it's been really tough. Finding out Lily is moving is just... too much right now.

p11/p11_conv_4:10.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:10.text: I totally understand. Repeating your story is exhausting. Remember, it's okay to give yourself that space to feel and reach out for support when you're ready.

p11/p11_conv_4:11.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:11.text: Thanks. I just miss how things were before when it felt like I could handle everything.

p11/p11_conv_4:12.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:12.text: You were really juggling a lot! It’s okay to feel thrown off by changes and challenges. You don't have to handle it all perfectly.

p11/p11_conv_4:13.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:13.text: Yeah. I know you're right. I just wish everything would slow down for a bit.

p11/p11_conv_4:14.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:14.text: It’s normal to want a breather. Are there things that usually help you find a little peace or distraction?

p11/p11_conv_4:15.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:15.text: I used to read a lot, but I haven't been able to lose myself in a book for a while.

p11/p11_conv_4:16.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:16.text: Maybe trying a new book could help, even if it’s just a distraction for a bit. Staying connected with those things that bring you comfort is important.

p11/p11_conv_4:17.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:17.text: That's true. I'll try picking one up again. Thanks for being here and listening.

p11/p11_conv_4:18.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:18.text: Always here for you, Anna. Take things one step at a time and remember, you're not alone in this.

p11/p11_conv_4:2.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:2.text: I can only imagine how overwhelming that must feel. You've already been dealing with so much lately.

p11/p11_conv_4:3.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:3.text: Yeah, it feels like everything's just piling up. First it was the fight with my boyfriend, then the argument with my parents, and now this.

p11/p11_conv_4:4.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:4.text: It sounds like a lot to carry all at once. How are you managing with your school work amidst everything?

p11/p11_conv_4:5.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:5.text: Not well, honestly. My midterm results were a disaster and I can't focus on studying with all this emotional stress.

p11/p11_conv_4:6.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:6.text: That makes sense. It would be hard for anyone to focus with so many things happening at once. Have you talked to your teachers about what's going on?

p11/p11_conv_4:7.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:7.text: No, I haven't. I'm worried they won't understand and just tell me to focus more.

p11/p11_conv_4:8.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_4:8.text: I get that. It can be scary to open up about everything. Maybe talking to a school counselor might help you manage the stress better?

p11/p11_conv_4:9.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_4:9.text: I guess that's a good idea. But I'm just so tired of explaining everything over and over, you know?

p11/p11_conv_5:0.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:0.text: Hey, do you have a moment?

p11/p11_conv_5:1.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:1.text: Of course, Anna. What's on your mind?

p11/p11_conv_5:10.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:10.text: I tried talking to my parents, but we just end up arguing about future plans. They don't really get it.

p11/p11_conv_5:11.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:11.text: It sounds like you're not feeling heard by them. That must be so frustrating.

p11/p11_conv_5:12.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:12.text: Yeah, and it just adds to the stress. My midterms were bad, and now there's more pressure to improve.

p11/p11_conv_5:13.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:13.text: Dealing with academic pressure on top of everything else is really tough. Remember, grades don't define your worth.

p11/p11_conv_5:14.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:14.text: I know they don't. It's just hard, especially with everyone seeming to have it all together.

p11/p11_conv_5:15.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:15.text: It's easy to feel that way, but everyone struggles in different ways. It's okay to focus on you and your journey.

p11/p11_conv_5:16.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:16.text: Thanks. I really needed to hear that. I guess I just need to take things one step at a time.

p11/p11_conv_5:17.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:17.text: Absolutely, taking things step by step is key. And remember, I'm always here to talk whenever you need.

p11/p11_conv_5:18.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:18.text: I appreciate it. I'm feeling a bit better already. Maybe I'll try talking to Rachel and see if we can support each other.

p11/p11_conv_5:19.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:19.text: That's a great idea, Anna. Supporting each other sounds like a wonderful step forward. You both deserve it.

p11/p11_conv_5:2.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:2.text: It's just been a lot lately. My friend at school, Rachel, is going through something really tough.

p11/p11_conv_5:20.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:20.text: Thank you so much for listening. It means a lot.

p11/p11_conv_5:21.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:21.text: Anytime. You're doing amazing, and I'm here to remind you of that whenever you need.

p11/p11_conv_5:3.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It must be difficult to see a friend in pain.

p11/p11_conv_5:4.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:4.text: Yeah, it really is. I want to be there for her, but I'm worried I'm not doing enough.

p11/p11_conv_5:5.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:5.text: It's understandable to feel that way. You're already doing more than you realize just by being concerned.

p11/p11_conv_5:6.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:6.text: Thanks, I guess. But with everything else going on... Lily leaving, my grades slipping, and recent fights... it's a lot.

p11/p11_conv_5:7.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:7.text: That's a huge emotional load to carry. I'm really sorry about Lily moving. Have you been able to talk to anyone about how overwhelming this is?

p11/p11_conv_5:8.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_5:8.text: Not really. I feel like a mess and I'm scared of burdening others with my problems.

p11/p11_conv_5:9.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_5:9.text: It's okay to feel like a mess, Anna. You shouldn't have to go through this alone. Reaching out for support is a sign of strength.

p11/p11_conv_6:0.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:0.text: Hey, I hope you're doing well. I wanted to talk about something that's been on my mind lately.

p11/p11_conv_6:1.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:1.text: Hey Anna, I'm here to listen. What's been going on?

p11/p11_conv_6:10.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:10.text: Not really. I've been afraid that it'll make things worse for them. Sometimes, I think all of this is just too much for me to handle.

p11/p11_conv_6:11.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:11.text: You're doing the best you can, and it's okay to feel that way. It's brave of you to acknowledge these feelings and reach out for support.

p11/p11_conv_6:12.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:12.text: Thanks, it means a lot. I guess I'm just trying to find my way through all this chaos.

p11/p11_conv_6:13.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:13.text: You're taking steps forward, and that shows strength. Have you found any part of the tutoring club comforting or enjoyable?

p11/p11_conv_6:14.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:14.text: I actually met a few people who seem nice. And helping others with their studies has given me a small confidence boost.

p11/p11_conv_6:15.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:15.text: That's wonderful to hear. It can sometimes help to focus on those positive interactions and see small victories as they come.

p11/p11_conv_6:16.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:16.text: Yeah, I think holding onto those good moments might really help. I just need to remind myself that it's okay to take things one step at a time.

p11/p11_conv_6:17.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:17.text: Absolutely, one step at a time. You're quite resilient, Anna, and I'm here for you whenever you need to talk.

p11/p11_conv_6:18.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:18.text: Thank you so much. I'm really grateful to have someone who listens and understands.

p11/p11_conv_6:19.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:19.text: Anytime, Anna. Keep reaching out when you need it, and remember that you're not alone.

p11/p11_conv_6:2.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:2.text: I recently joined a peer tutoring club at school because I wanted to improve my grades and, you know, maybe make some new friends.

p11/p11_conv_6:3.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:3.text: That sounds like a great step forward! How has it been going so far?

p11/p11_conv_6:4.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:4.text: It's been okay, but I feel like I'm just pretending to be alright. I'm still so worried about my grades and even more about other things.

p11/p11_conv_6:5.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:5.text: It's completely understandable to feel overwhelmed. Joining the club shows you're taking proactive steps, but what other worries are on your mind?

p11/p11_conv_6:6.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:6.text: You know how Lily is moving abroad, right? It's really hitting me hard. Plus, there's the whole argument I had with my parents about my future.

p11/p11_conv_6:7.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:7.text: That's a lot to deal with. It's tough when friends move away, especially someone as close as Lily. And those conversations with parents can be really stressful.

p11/p11_conv_6:8.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_6:8.text: Yeah, exactly. I also feel guilty because I want to be there for Rachel, who's dealing with a personal loss. But I'm not sure I'm strong enough for that.

p11/p11_conv_6:9.speaker: supporter
p11/p11_conv_6:9.text: Balancing your own struggles with trying to support someone else's isn't easy. It's important to care for yourself too. Have you been able to talk to Rachel about how you're feeling?

p11/p11_conv_7:0.speaker: seeker
p11/p11_conv_7:0.text: Hey, I really need someone to talk to.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, I find that has helped me a bit also because I have quite a short attention span . Also, I am currently on the path of trying to find more unique techniques to help revision more fun and exciting for me

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I love art and writing, but I'm not sure if that's practical. It feels risky compared to more traditional paths.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I like to read book. Shall I try this?

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I love art and writing, but I'm not sure if that's practical. It feels risky compared to more traditional paths.

64321321472edf0b28f167520cb4f7f104ef2d66.statement: seeker considers having an older person talk to parents to mediate parental pressure

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I sometimes feel like someone older needs to talk to them, maybe then my parents may take it more seriously

bdca517093094d61c018f7ade2c3d4466ae542e1.head: ME
bdca517093094d61c018f7ade2c3d4466ae542e1.statement: seeker tried to talk with friends about broken trust

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It may be misunderstanding. I tried to talk with them.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I'll try to keep that in mind. Thanks for listening, it helps a lot to talk things through.

c33ecd92ad75ffc241efad6fbf3841e24cb43100.head: ME
c33ecd92ad75ffc241efad6fbf3841e24cb43100.statement: finds relief in emotional support during conversation

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thanks. It helps to know I'm not alone in this.
